name: neobrutalism
label: Neobrutalism
css: .style-neobrutalism { background-color: var(--slide-surface, #FBFBF9); border: 3px solid var(--slide-primary, #FDC800); position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; padding: 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; box-sizing: border-box; } .style-neobrutalism::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; border: 3px solid var(--slide-primary, #FDC800); pointer-events: none; z-index: 1; } .style-neobrutalism .hook { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1; color: var(--slide-text, #1C293C); margin: 0; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -2px; z-index: 2; position: relative; } .style-neobrutalism .text { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--slide-text, #1C293C); margin: 0; z-index: 2; position: relative; max-width: 90%; } .style-neobrutalism .step { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-text, #1C293C); opacity: 0.08; position: absolute; top: 16px; right: 16px; margin: 0; z-index: 0; line-height: 1; } .style-neobrutalism .brand { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-text, #1C293C); position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 32px; margin: 0; letter-spacing: 0.5px; z-index: 2; } .slide-code.style-neobrutalism { background-color: #1C293C; border-color: var(--slide-primary, #FDC800); } .slide-code.style-neobrutalism .hook, .slide-code.style-neobrutalism .text, .slide-code.style-neobrutalism .brand, .slide-code.style-neobrutalism .step { color: #FBFBF9; } .slide-code.style-neobrutalism .step { color: #FBFBF9; opacity: 0.12; } .slide-insight.style-neobrutalism { background-color: #1C293C; border-color: var(--slide-primary, #FDC800); } .slide-insight.style-neobrutalism .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #FDC800); } .slide-insight.style-neobrutalism .text { color: #FBFBF9; } .slide-insight.style-neobrutalism .brand { color: #FBFBF9; } .slide-insight.style-neobrutalism .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #FDC800); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-neobrutalism .insight-text { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: #FBFBF9; background-color: rgba(253, 200, 0, 0.1); border-left: 4px solid var(--slide-primary, #FDC800); padding: 24px; margin: 24px 0; position: relative; z-index: 2; }
